_about: Fixes for the Brazilian Portuguese translation (Traduções PKG) of the European disc in Super Mario 3D All-Stars, which replaced its Spanish, for tools/make_disc_translation_pack.py: the lines 3D All-Stars reworded for the Switch's controls, back to the GameCube's buttons; Spanish ¡ dropped; the Noki Bay episode name and the Delfino Plaza line the translation left out (the later ones were one early); Pianta Village 7's text, which the translation put in Noki Bay's file (mare6), whose four lines come from its other stages; and the Ricco Harbor launches whose timing codes became text. The eight lines it left in Spanish (Pinna Park 1, Ricco Harbor 8, Hotel Delfino (delfino1) and Pianta Village 3), which it translated nowhere else, are this file's own translations.
